title: Android export preset causes persistent system-wide busy/loading cursor on Windows
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in: 4.6.3.stable
Not tested in other versions.

### System information

Godot v4.6.3.stable (7d41c59c4) - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Direct3D 12 (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9621) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-9700F CPU @ 3.00GHz (8 threads) - 31.94 GiB memory

### Issue description

When an Android export preset exists in the project (export_presets.cfg), 
the Windows mouse cursor shows a persistent system-wide busy/loading spinner 
whenever the project is open in the editor, even when completely idle and 
nothing is running. This is reproducible on a completely empty project with 
no scripts, assets or autoloads -- just adding an Android export preset is 
enough to trigger it.

Workaround: Deleting export_presets.cfg and reloading the project stops the 
busy/loading spinner from appearing on the cursor. Deleting the file without 
reloading the project does not stop it.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a new empty project
2. Go to Project -> Export and add an Android preset
3. Close the export dialog
4. Notice the system-wide busy/loading spinner appears on the cursor 
immediately and persists as long as the project is open in the editor

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A - reproducible in a brand new empty project
